cohort: 935 mother-infant pairs from the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development (CHILD) birth cohort
finding: This study found that birth mode and infant gut microbiota (specifically Firmicutes species richness, especially of the Lachnospiraceae family) sequentially mediated the association between maternal prepregnancy overweight and childhood overweight at ages 1 and 3 years.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean delivery to overweight mothers had a five-fold increased risk of overweight at age 1 year compared to infants born vaginally to mothers of normal weight.
